A '''hepatizon dolabra''' is the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] [[dolabra]], made by smithing a [[Copper Axe|copper axe]] with [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]]. It mines at speed 15 and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_dolabra.json}}</ref>

As a [[dolabra]], it works as both a pickaxe and an axe, at a lower mining speed than the hepatizon pickaxe or axe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot, which is not used up. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so a [[Copper Dolabra|copper dolabra]] works as the base as well as a copper axe. Without the template, the same base and alloy make a [[Hepatizon Axe|hepatizon axe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/hepatizon/dolabra</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 15. Hepatizon has the highest base mining speeds of any tier.

Its tool rules have no obsidian restriction, so it mines obsidian with drops at its normal speed, although the [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]] notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant tools can mine obsidian.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_dolabra.json}}</ref>

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 7 damage with an attack speed of 1.

Held in the main hand, it adds 0.005 to movement speed (5% of the base speed).

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_dolabra.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added translation support for all armor and tools.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Hepatizon was renamed from "Bronze" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Buffed hepatizon equipment.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. Mining speed raised from about 12 to 15.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Dolabras were redefined as axe (tool) and pickaxe hybrids rather than weapons: damage goes down and weapon intrinsics are removed over time.}}
}}
